usage.outputShape: body.images[0].url (PNG, 1024x1024); also body.images[0].width/height, body.seed, body.model, body.inference_time_ms
usage.guide: POST a JSON body {"prompt":"..."} to the endpoint; pay $0.10 USDC via x402 (Base eip155:8453, also Tempo/Solana accepted). Response is plain sync JSON: read the generated image URL at body.images[0].url (1024x1024 PNG hosted on fal.media). No auth beyond payment, no polling.
